[[Korrub's Vision]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[focus item]] dropped by [[Korrub, Flame of Dreams]], a [[boss]] who can be found in the [[Wilderness of Bahdza]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +12 (Requires 9 [[Domination Magic]]) 
:Domination Magic +1 (Chance: 20%) 
:[[Health]] +30

==Replica==
It is possible to create an exact replica for this item with:
*[[Inscribed Chakram]] from collectors [[Kiishen]] or [[Kristoffir Roi]] or crafter [[Sheco]]
OR
*[[Inscribed Chakram]] from collector [[Jwup]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|Master of My Domain]]" inscription
OR
*[[Inscribed Chakram]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Derrick]], [[Hadusi]], [[Shausha]], [[Soros]], or [[Tehshan]]
*Perfect [[Focus Core]] [[of Fortitude]]
*Perfect "[[Inscription|Master of My Domain]]" inscription
AND
*Black [[dye]]

== Unique counterpart ==
* [[Korvald's Chakram]] 
** These two items have differing descriptions: Korvald's states that it will boost Domination Magic by +1 with a ''"20% chance while using skills"'', while Korrub's reads "''20% chance''".
** However, both items work identically: the 20% chance is conditional on using Domination Magic and only affects the skill (e.g. it will not add +6 energy to a character with only rank 8 in Domination Magic).
